environment.description: Same Actix-web binary deployed behind an Envoy sidecar proxy (v1.28) with a custom Lua filter chain. The Envoy configuration includes a per-route rate limit descriptor keyed on {source_ip, request_path=/oauth/authorize} with a token bucket of 3 requests per 60-second window, enforced by an external ratelimit service (envoyproxy/ratelimit with Redis backend). When the bucket is exhausted, Envoy returns 429 before the request reaches the Actix-web process. Additionally, the Envoy route configuration for /oauth/authorize includes a header_mutation filter that strips and re-encodes the redirect_uri query parameter through a strict URL canonicalization step (using Envoy's path_with_escaped_slashes_action: UNESCAPE_AND_REDIRECT and custom Lua that rejects any redirect_uri where the parsed hostname contains characters outside [a-z0-9.-]), which prevents the subdomain confusion attack vector by rejecting hostnames like 'evil.myapp.com.attacker.io' before the application processes them.

lua_filter.logic: extract redirect_uri param, parse as URL, reject if hostname matches /[^a-z0-9.\-]/ or if hostname does not exactly match an entry in allowlist after canonicalization
